caption: GA/ES reporting follows the PPO resource amendment. PPO reporting is deferred; completion of this scope leaves the original three-method target incomplete. Development and diagnostic results remain separate. Dispersion is sample SD across trials, not a confidence interval. Training steps are nominal episode-cap budgets; evaluation is separate. Raw reward units and /500 normalization differ from paper reference-based rescaling.
